lines.en: label sadgirls7:
scene makotoyay1
When I was younger, I watched a woman’s head split open after a collision with the concrete.
lines.zh: 我小时候,亲眼看到一个女人的头在撞上水泥地之后裂开。

lines.en: I was clutching my mother’s hand as if it were a life raft and I was lost in the ocean.
lines.zh: 我紧紧抓着母亲的手,像抓着救生筏,而我是迷失在海里的人。

lines.en: She pulled me inside to shield me from learning about death long before I was meant to.
lines.zh: 她把我拉进屋里,免得我在本该知道之前就提前认识了死亡。

lines.en: In hindsight, I wish she wouldn’t have.
lines.zh: 现在回想,我真希望她没有这么做。

lines.en: scene makotoyay2
It happened outside of the grocery store.
lines.zh: 那是在杂货店外面发生的。

lines.en: We kept on shopping, ignoring the blare of the sirens — so loud that they overtook the music on the store radio and became the soundtrack to our trip for the day.
lines.zh: 我们继续买东西,对刺耳的警笛声充耳不闻——那声音大得盖过了店里广播的音乐,成了我们那天出行的配乐。

lines.en: There is one moment I can recall where the sirens perfectly aligned with the tune of a song.
lines.zh: 我还记得有那么一个瞬间,警笛声和一首歌的曲调完美重合。

lines.en: Like a parallelogram, they combined and stretched out forever — past the dying woman and deep into the street...
lines.zh: 就像一个平行四边形,它们合在一起,永远地延伸出去——越过那个垂死的女人,深入街道……

lines.en: Off into the horizon...leaving a wake of intangible destruction as it went.
lines.zh: 一直延伸到地平线……沿途留下无形的破坏的尾迹。

lines.en: I followed the lines until their very end, but only in my mind as my hand still rested in that of my mother’s and I wasn’t old enough to wander off on my own yet.
lines.zh: 我追着那些线一直追到它们尽头,不过只是在脑子里——因为我的手还握在母亲手里,而我还没大到可以自己跑开。

lines.en: I understand why now.
lines.zh: 现在我明白为什么了。

lines.en: For when the lines ended, I was met with nothing more than pitch black.
lines.zh: 因为当那些线到头的时候,迎接我的只有一片漆黑。

lines.en: And a single white clock, dissolving into nothingness.
lines.zh: 还有一只白色的钟,正溶解进虚无。

lines.en: scene black
I look down while I’m walking now.
lines.zh: 现在我走路的时候会低头看。

lines.en: Just to make sure no lines cross over me.
lines.zh: 只为了确保没有线从我身上穿过。

lines.en: scene makotoyay3
I recall another hand, far bigger than that of my mother’s.
lines.zh: 我想起另一只手,比我母亲的那只大得多。

lines.en: With a large, clock-colored eraser pressed between its thumb and its forefinger, it reached off into the distance and started rubbing away the remnants of an unreadily dispatched soul.
lines.zh: 它的拇指和食指之间捏着一块大大的、钟的颜色般的橡皮,朝远处伸过去,开始擦去一个尚未准备好就被送走的灵魂的残迹。

lines.en: But each line it erased only became longer at the end without attention.
lines.zh: 可它擦掉的每一条线,一不留神就在末端变得更长。

lines.en: And each fleck of rubber that peeled and fell off of the eraser while it attempted to fulfill its only purpose was replaced with a sprouting sunflower.
lines.zh: 而橡皮在试图完成它唯一使命时剥落掉下的每一粒碎屑,都被一株正在发芽的向日葵取代了。

lines.en: It was in that moment that it dawned on me.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻,我恍然大悟。

lines.en: The idea that the most beautiful of things can still grow in the shadows of all that is evil.
lines.zh: 最美的事物,依然可以在一切邪恶的阴影里生长。

lines.en: And it is for that reason that I call myself what I do today.
lines.zh: 也正因如此,我今天才这样称呼自己。

lines.en: For that hand was yours.
lines.zh: 因为那只手是你的。

lines.en: And that flower was me.
lines.zh: 而那朵花是我。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain1
: Uhh...Makoto?
lines.zh: : 呃……Makoto?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛?

lines.en: : There’s someone here to see you.
lines.zh: : 有人来看你。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain2
: Sorry, but I’m not accepting any visitors right now. Please ask whoever it is to go away.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我现在不接待任何访客。不管是谁,请让他走吧。

lines.en: : Even if it’s me?
lines.zh: : 就算是我?

lines.en: : It doesn’t make a difference who you are. I said I’m not accepting visitors.
lines.zh: : 不管你是谁都没差别。我说了我不接待访客。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain3
: Well, I tried.
lines.zh: : 好吧,我试过了。

lines.en: : Did you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真的试过了吗?

lines.en: : {i}Tried?{/i}
: Tried what?
lines.zh: : 试什么?

lines.en: : Did you think bringing him here would cheer me up?
lines.zh: : 你以为把他带过来我就会开心起来?

lines.en: : Do you think I’m an inconvenience because I’m not handling this as well as you? Is that what’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 你是不是觉得,因为我没有像你一样处理好这件事,我就是个麻烦?这就是你的意思吗?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain4
: What? Of course not. You’re not an inconvenience at all. I just hate seeing you like-
lines.zh: : 什么?当然不是。你根本不是什么麻烦。我只是不喜欢看到你这样——

lines.en: : Get out.
lines.zh: : 出去。

lines.en: : Makoto, please. I brought him all this way here to-
lines.zh: : Makoto,拜托。我大老远把他带来——

lines.en: : Not him. You. Leave.
lines.zh: : 不是他。是你。出去。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain5
: You shouldn’t talk to your mother like that.
lines.zh: : 你不该那样跟你妈妈说话。

lines.en: : Oh? Are {i}you{/i} my dad now? Hooray. Everything is good again.
lines.zh: : 哦?那{i}你{/i}现在是我爸了?万岁。一切又都好起来了。

lines.en: : Let’s all hold hands and forget that the last one is never coming back.
lines.zh: : 大家手牵手,忘掉上一个永远不会回来了。

lines.en: : I get that you’re upset. But you need to apologize to-
lines.zh: : 我知道你很难过。但你必须道歉——

lines.en: scene makotosadagain6
: It’s fine, really.  You don’t have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事,真的。你不用放在心上。

lines.en: : I kind of figured something like this was going to happen anyway.
lines.zh: : 我本来就多少料到会发生这种事。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain7
: {i}Hey, now.{/i} What’s that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : {i}喂{/i},等等。这话是什么意思?

lines.en: : Have I become so predictably horrible as a daughter that you just expect me to turn you away now?
lines.zh: : 我是不是已经坏得这么有规律了,连你都预料到我会把你赶走?

lines.en: : Or do you think that {i}maybe{/i} I’d just have an easier time grieving without being reminded every thirty seconds that my father is dead?
lines.zh: : 还是说你觉得,如果不用每三十秒就被提醒一次我父亲死了,我会更容易哀悼一些?

lines.en: : You know that’s not-
lines.zh: : 你知道我不是——

lines.en: : Why are you still here? I asked you to leave.
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这儿?我让你出去。

lines.en: : I’ll humor you and let Sensei try to “snap me out of this.” But if I were in your shoes, I’d probably use that time to prepare myself because, chances are, your daughter’s never coming back either.
lines.zh: : 我给你个面子,让 Sensei 试着「把我从这状态里拉出来」。不过如果我是你,我大概会趁这段时间做好心理准备,因为很有可能,你女儿也永远不会回来了。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain8
: That’s not true...
lines.zh: : 那不是真的……

lines.en: : You’re still you...and all of this is just temporary.
lines.zh: : 你还是你……而这一切都只是暂时的。

lines.en: : Oh, give me a fucking break with the cliche consolation lines like “all of this is temporary” and “things will get better.”
lines.zh: : 哦,省省吧,别拿「这一切都是暂时的」「事情会好起来的」这种老套的安慰词来糊弄我。

lines.en: : At least Sensei will be able to come up with more creative ways to remind me of why I shouldn’t be crying during the saddest day of my life. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 至少 Sensei 能想出更有创意的方式,来提醒我为什么在我这辈子最难过的一天不该哭。对吧,Sensei?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain9
: Makoto! You’re not the only one who lost someone, you know?! He meant just as much to me as he did to you!
lines.zh: : Makoto!你不是唯一失去的人,你知道吗?!他对我来说,和对你是同样重要的!

lines.en: : Yeah? That’s good to know. It was hard to keep track of {i}who{/i} meant {i}what{/i} to {i}who{/i} with all of those extra people always coming in and out of the house.
lines.zh: : 是吗?那可真让人欣慰。家里总有那么多人进进出出,很难记清{i}谁{/i}对{i}谁{/i}意味着{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain10
: That...didn’t have anything to do with-
lines.zh: : 那……跟这没关系——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. Explain it later. I’m done dealing with you for now. Bring on the next contestant.
lines.zh: : 是是是。回头再解释。我现在不想应付你了。请下一位选手上场。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain11
: Do you intend to shit talk me as well when I’m {i}also{/i} here to help you?
lines.zh: : 我{i}同样{/i}也是来帮你的,你也打算这么骂我?

lines.en: : You’re here because you were fucking kidnapped, weren’t you? This isn’t something {i}you{/i} would plan.
lines.zh: : 你之所以在这儿,是因为你他妈被绑来的,对吧?这可不是{i}你{/i}会主动计划的事。

lines.en: : You’d tell me to get the fuck over it and learn how to deal with things on my own because that’s what I’m supposed to do! Isn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 你会叫我他妈的赶紧振作起来,学会自己解决问题,因为那才是我应该做的!不是吗?!

lines.en: : No. That’s-
lines.zh: : 不。那是——

lines.en: scene makotosadagain12
: Isn’t it?!?!
: ...As I was trying to say, no. This is different from all of those other times. Different enough that I’ve had a hard time thinking of anything {i}but{/i} this since I walked into that bathroom.
lines.zh: : ……我正想说的是,不。这一次和之前那些都不一样。不一样到,从我走进那间洗手间之后,我几乎没法想{i}别{/i}的事。

lines.en: : Oh, good! If all it took was a fucking {i}death{/i} for you to start worrying about me, perhaps I should have killed someone myself!
lines.zh: : 哦,真好!如果只要{i}死{/i}个人就能让你开始担心我,那也许我该自己动手杀一个!

lines.en: : That’s not what he’s saying, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 他不是那个意思,Makoto!

lines.en: : Why are you still here?! I told you to leave!
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这儿?!我让你出去!

lines.en: scene makotosadagain13
: I’ll take it from here, Maki. I remember the way out, so I can just come meet you in the shop when I’m done.
lines.zh: : 接下来交给我吧,Maki。我认得出去的路,等我谈完就去店里找你。

lines.en: : Good. She was starting to test my patience anyway.
lines.zh: : 好。反正她已经开始考验我的耐心了。

lines.en: : Hallelujah! Praise fucking be!
lines.zh: : 哈利路亚!他妈的谢天谢地!

lines.en: scene makotosadagain14
: I just want you to feel better, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你好受一点,Makoto。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if I went about it the wrong way.
lines.zh: : 如果我的方式不对,我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain15
Maki leaves the room, exhibiting a surprising amount of self control by not slamming the door on her way out.
lines.zh: Maki 离开了房间,展现出了惊人的自制力——她出门时没有摔门。

lines.en: I understand that we all have our own ways of processing grief...and I understand even better just how much Makoto cared for her father.
lines.zh: 我理解,我们每个人都有自己处理悲伤的方式……而我更理解 Makoto 有多在乎她父亲。

lines.en: But even then, I can’t help but feel like she’s being extremely unfair to a woman who’s been bending over backwards and sidelining her own grief just to deal with {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: 但即便如此,我还是忍不住觉得,她对那个女人实在太不公平了——那个女人一直在拼尽全力,把自己的悲伤搁在一边,只为处理眼前{i}这件事{/i}。

lines.en: If I were a parent in this scenario, I’d simply let my child rot.
lines.zh: 如果我处在这样的父母的位子上,我大概会干脆放任我的孩子烂掉。

lines.en: So I guess it’s good that I’m not.
lines.zh: 所以我想,还好我不是。

lines.en: And that I won’t ever be.
lines.zh: 也还好我永远不会是。

lines.en: Because it wouldn’t be fair to subject someone to that.
lines.zh: 因为让一个人承受这些是不公平的。

lines.en: Now, please excuse me as my hypocrisy reigns supreme once more.
lines.zh: 现在,请原谅我,我的虚伪又要再一次占据上风了。

lines.en: : Does being a bitch to your mother like that really make you feel any better?
lines.zh: : 那样冲你妈妈发脾气,真的能让你好受一点吗?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain16
: A little bit, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点点,对。

lines.en: : Why? You do realize she’s taking this just as badly as you are, right?
lines.zh: : 为什么?你知道她跟你一样难受吧?

lines.en: : Dressed like {i}that?{/i} Yeah, I don’t think so. You needn’t look any further than the clothes we’re wearing to tell she doesn’t give a shit.
lines.zh: : 穿成{i}那样{/i}?是啊,我可不这么想。光看我们俩身上的衣服,就知道她根本不在乎。

lines.en: : Wanna know what I really think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 想知道我真正的想法吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} think she’s dressed like that because she wants somebody to fuck her so hard that she just {i}forgets{/i} my dad.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}觉得她穿成那样,是因为她想让谁狠狠操她一顿,好让她{i}忘了{/i}我爸。

lines.en: : Seriously?
lines.zh: : 说真的?

lines.en: : What? It wouldn’t be the first time I’ve heard her getting her brains screwed out by some random guy.
lines.zh: : 怎么?我又不是第一次听见她被某个陌生男人操得神志不清。

lines.en: : Want a shot? She’s fresh on the market. And her clothes are already halfway off. Saves you some of the hassle.
lines.zh: : 想试试吗?她刚回到市场上。而且衣服已经脱掉一半了。省了你不少麻烦。

lines.en: : Sounds good, actually. I’m sure that hearing me go to town on your mother while you’re stuck inside of your room will do plenty of good for your current state of mind.
lines.zh: : 听起来倒是不错。我相信,你被困在自己房间里、听着我在你妈身上卖力,对你现在的精神状态一定大有好处。

lines.en: : But what about {i}your{/i} state of mind, Sensei? What if you’re not able to get it up for someone who’s already done growing?
lines.zh: : 不过 Sensei,{i}你的{/i}精神状态呢?万一你面对一个已经停止发育的人,硬不起来怎么办?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain17
: Oh well. Whatever. Just don’t come crying back to me when her insides are a little too “beat up” for you.
lines.zh: : 唉,算了。随便吧。只是等她的里面对你来说「用得太狠」了,别回来找我哭。

lines.en: : I can’t speak from experience since you’re the only man who’s ever put his dick in me, but I’m pretty sure she might be a little too stretched out to appeal to your...{i}tastes{/i} by now.
lines.zh: : 我没有经验可谈,毕竟你是唯一一个把鸡巴放进过我身体里的男人,但我敢肯定,她现在大概已经被撑得有点太松,入不了你的……{i}胃口{/i}了。

lines.en: : Okay...can I sit? And can we talk about something that doesn’t involve sex?
lines.zh: : 好吧……我能坐下吗?还有,我们能聊点跟性无关的事吗?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain18
: Wow! If I hadn’t already picked out my funeral dress, I might have thought it was my birthday after hearing that.
lines.zh: : 哇!如果我没有已经挑好葬礼穿的衣服,听到这话我大概会以为今天是我生日。

lines.en: : Welcome to the party, Sensei. The seat at the head of the table is free now.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临这场派对,Sensei。桌子主位的位子现在空着。

lines.en: : My legs have grown since my dad last sat in it. So if we’re careful, I might even be able to give you a stealthy footjob while my mom tricks herself into believing we’re a big, happy family again.
lines.zh: : 我爸上次坐那儿之后,我的腿长长了不少。所以如果我们小心点,我甚至能偷偷用脚给你来一发,而我妈就自欺欺人地以为我们又是幸福快乐的一家人了。

lines.en: : Would you rather I just leave?
lines.zh: : 你更希望我直接走?

lines.en: : Do you want the honest answer to that? Or do you want to sit down {i}regardless{/i} of what I want because it makes you feel better about yourself?
lines.zh: : 你想听诚实的回答?还是说你想{i}不管{/i}我愿不愿意都坐下,因为那样能让你自我感觉更好?

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll sit. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我坐。谢了。

lines.en: : Ooooh, look at you. Breezing right past my subtle digs at your character like they don’t actually hurt. Sure wish {i}I{/i} could do that.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦,瞧瞧你。轻飘飘地就略过了我那些对你为人的暗讽,好像它们真的不伤人似的。我真希望{i}我{/i}也能这样。

lines.en: I take a seat beside Makoto, expecting her to slide away, but she doesn’t move at all.
lines.zh: 我在 Makoto 身边坐下,本以为她会挪开,可她一动不动。

lines.en: In fact, she grows silent the second I’m closer to her- locking her hostility inside of a box, as temporary as it may be.
lines.zh: 事实上,我一靠近她,她就安静了下来——把敌意锁进了一个盒子里,不管这状态有多短暂。

lines.en: As I look down at her, I wonder if the disparity in size between us is the primary reason for her newfound silence.
lines.zh: 我低头看着她,忍不住想,我们之间体型的悬殊,是不是她突然安静下来的首要原因。

lines.en: I wonder if she feels safer now that there’s someone who could envelop her entire body in a single embrace just one foot away.
lines.zh: 我想知道,现在一英尺开外有个能一整个把她抱住的人,她是不是觉得更安全了。

lines.en: I wonder if that type of embrace is something she longs for in this moment.
lines.zh: 我想知道,此刻她是不是正渴望着那样的拥抱。

lines.en: Or if it would send her spiraling even further into a pit that she will never return from.
lines.zh: 还是说,那只会让她更深地坠进一个她再也爬不出来的坑里。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain19
: Do you want to talk? Or would you rather sit here in silence?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗?还是更想就这么坐着不说话?

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I’m new to this whole “dead dad” thing.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我对「死掉的爸爸」这一整套还很陌生。

lines.en: : I see that, at the very least, you get your sense of humor from your mother. She said something eerily similar yesterday morning.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来,至少你的幽默感是遗传自你妈妈。她昨天早上说了句几乎一模一样的话。

lines.en: : Wow, it’s almost like we’re related or something.
lines.zh: : 哇,简直像我们真有血缘关系似的。

lines.en: : You don’t actually dislike her, do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实并不讨厌她,对吧?

lines.en: : What do {i}you{/i} think about her, Sensei? You know, since you two are such close friends now.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}觉得她怎么样,Sensei?毕竟你们俩现在关系这么好。

lines.en: : I like her a lot, actually. She reminds me of this one girl that’s been following me around like a puppy since the school year began.
lines.zh: : 其实我很喜欢她。她让我想起一个从开学起就像小狗一样跟在我身后的女孩。

lines.en: : Ami, because of how annoying she is? Ayane, because it seems as if she’s always in heat?
lines.zh: : Ami,因为她很烦人?Ayane,因为她好像总是在发情?

lines.en: : I’m talking about you, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我说的显然是你。

lines.en: : And, for the record, you are also very annoying and have a surprisingly high sex drive.
lines.zh: : 而且顺便说一句,你同样非常烦人,而且性欲高得惊人。

lines.en: : Yeah well, when you grow up surrounded by rubber cocks and screams of pleasure, you tend to find yourself getting interested in certain things at a very unhealthy age.
lines.zh: : 是啦,当你是被橡胶鸡巴和愉悦的尖叫声包围着长大的,你往往会在一个非常不健康的年纪对某些东西产生兴趣。

lines.en: : Apart from that, though, my mother and I are nothing alike. We never have been.
lines.zh: : 不过除此之外,我和我妈一点都不像。从来都不像。

lines.en: : Well...spend a little more time focusing on {i}her{/i} rather than everything else and maybe you’ll change your mind.
lines.zh: : 嗯……多花点时间关注{i}她{/i},而不是别的那些东西,也许你会改变想法。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain20
: Did she pay you to say that? Is that part of your {i}mission{/i} today?
lines.zh: : 她花钱让你这么说的吗?这是你今天的「{i}任务{/i}」的一部分?

lines.en: : If she did pay me to say that, you two would be even more alike. Because I distinctly recall you paying Miku on at least one occasion to...try to get me to fall for you or something.
lines.zh: : 如果她真花钱让我这么说,那你们俩就更像了。因为我清楚记得,你至少有那么一次花钱雇 Miku……想让我喜欢上你什么的。

lines.en: : A decision that very well paid off in the fact that my hymen is now just as present as my father.
lines.zh: : 这个决定回报颇丰——我的处女膜现在和我父亲一样,已经不在了。

lines.en: : If you really think that had any bearing on my decision to ultimately sleep with you, I think there’s a lot you don’t understand about this relationship.
lines.zh: : 如果你真以为那对我最终和你上床的决定有什么影响,那我觉得,这段关系里有太多你没弄明白的东西。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not as if you make it easy to understand.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你也没让它变得容易理解啊。

lines.en: : But, for the purpose of both humoring you and finding {i}humor{/i} of my own, please tell me exactly {i}what{/i} you think I have in common with my mother.
lines.zh: : 不过,为了既哄你开心、也给自己找点{i}乐子{/i},请你具体说说,你觉得我和我妈有{i}什么{/i}共同点。

lines.en: : Because apart from our apparent shared sex drive and our looks, I struggle finding anything at all.
lines.zh: : 因为除了显而易见的性欲和外貌,我实在找不到任何别的。

lines.en: : Well, there’s the dark sense of humor you both use to try and push some of the sadness away...
lines.zh: : 嗯,你们都会用那种黑色幽默,试着把一部分悲伤推远……

lines.en: : There’s the overabundance of love you both have for Miku...
lines.zh: : 你们都对 Miku 有着多得溢出来的爱……

lines.en: : But more than just those, there’s this...compulsion you both have to never look weak.
lines.zh: : 但比这些更重要的,是你们都有一种……绝不显得软弱的强迫症。

lines.en: : Maki doesn’t look as fine as she does because she’s immune to this. She looks that way because she’s focusing everything she has on {i}you{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : Maki 看起来那么「没事」,不是因为她对这件事免疫。她看起来那样,是因为她此刻把她拥有的一切都倾注在{i}你{/i}身上。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain21
: Weren’t you crying {i}together{/i} when I walked into that bathroom?
lines.zh: : 我走进那间洗手间的时候,你们不是正抱在{i}一起{/i}哭吗?

lines.en: : How should I know? I can’t remember anything about the day I found out. And all I remember from the day after is crying so hard that I threw up.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道?我得知消息那天的事我什么都不记得了。而第二天我只记得自己哭到吐。

lines.en: : Well, she was. And before that, she burst into the classroom searching for you with a look I have never seen from her before.
lines.zh: : 嗯,她在。而在那之前,她冲进教室找你,脸上的表情是我从未见过的。

lines.en: : It wasn’t sadness, either. It was urgency. Like the only thing that mattered in that moment was finding you so you wouldn’t have to hear the news from some staff member in an office.
lines.zh: : 那甚至不是悲伤。是急迫。好像那一刻唯一重要的事就是找到你,好让你不必从办公室里某个职员口中听到这个消息。

lines.en: : Everything after that has been a marathon of unrestrained compassion for a daughter that she loves who can’t even find it in her to {i}return{/i} that love right now.
lines.zh: : 那之后的一切,都是一场毫无保留的怜惜的马拉松——给一个她爱着的女儿,而那个女儿此刻连一丝力气都拿不出来{i}回报{/i}这份爱。

lines.en: : Now, as one more person carrying the impossible, ingrained burden of never showing how I really feel, I obviously get that there’s a good reason for it. Which is why I’m not suggesting that you {i}change{/i} that part of you.
lines.zh: : 那么,作为一个同样背负着「永不流露真实感受」这种不可能的、根深蒂固的重担的人,我当然明白那是有理由的。所以我也不是要你{i}改变{/i}自己的这一部分。

lines.en: : I just think you’re smarter than actually believing your mom is completely unaffected by this.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,你足够聪明,不至于真的相信你妈完全没被这件事影响。

lines.en: : Maybe I am.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain22
: Maybe I {i}am{/i} smart enough to understand that...
lines.zh: : 也许我{i}确实{/i}聪明到能明白……

lines.en: : {i}But isn’t everything so much easier when you have someone else to blame?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可是,只要能怪到别人头上,一切不就都容易多了吗?{/i}

lines.en: scene makotosadagain23
: Isn’t it great knowing that the weight on your shoulders can just be passed on to someone else?! That burdens can become lighter whenever we want them to?!
lines.zh: : 知道自己肩上的重量可以就这么甩给别人,不是很棒吗?!知道重担可以随时变轻,不是很棒吗?!

lines.en: : It’s not {i}whenever we want.{/i} It’s whenever we can find someone willing to take that weight.
lines.zh: : 不是「{i}随时{/i}」。而是只要我们能找到一个愿意接下那份重量的人。

lines.en: : And in your case, you’re just lucky that you have someone who’d sacrifice the last bit of sanity in them so you can be one step closer to smiling.
lines.zh: : 而在你的情况里,你只是很幸运,有人愿意牺牲掉自己最后一点理智,好让你离笑容更近一步。

lines.en: : Lucky...
lines.zh: : 幸运……

lines.en: : Me...lucky...
: Me...the girl who just lost her one and only hero...
lines.zh: : 我……那个刚刚失去了自己唯一的英雄的女孩……

lines.en: : I’m lucky...
lines.zh: : 我很幸运……

lines.en: : I’m so lucky...
lines.zh: : 我真是太幸运了……

lines.en: : Okay...{i}lucky{/i} definitely wasn’t the best word choice on my part. But I’m sure you understand what I mean, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 好吧……「{i}幸运{/i}」确实不是我该选的词。不过我相信你明白我的意思,对吧?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain24
: Of course I understand, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我当然明白,Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m {i}smart...{/i}remember?
lines.zh: : 我很{i}聪明{/i}的……记得吗?

lines.en: : Though, I suppose I’m not the {i}smartest{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过,我想我不再是那个{i}最聪明{/i}的了。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t {i}be{/i} that smart if I wasn’t trying to impress someone.
lines.zh: : 可如果不是想打动某个人,我也不会那么聪明。

lines.en: : And before you go drowning yourself in narcissism again, allow me to clarify that I’m not talking about {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而在你又一次沉溺于自恋之前,请允许我澄清:我说的不是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : The reason I worked so hard all those years...why I nearly {b}KILLED MYSELF{/b} trying to become the best person I could be...
lines.zh: : 那些年我那么拼命的原因……为什么我几乎要{b}把自己逼死{/b},只为成为一个我能做到的最好的人……

lines.en: : It was all for him.
lines.zh: : 全都是为了他。

lines.en: : It was all to make him proud.
lines.zh: : 全都是为了让他骄傲。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain25
: {i}How am I gonna do that now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在我还怎么做到?{/i}

lines.en: : How am I supposed to keep being the best person I can be when the one thing {i}making{/i} me that person isn’t here anymore?
lines.zh: : 那个{i}让{/i}我成为那样的人的东西已经不在了,我还怎么继续做最好的自己?

lines.en: : I’ve got nothing left.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没有了。

lines.en: : And don’t tell me I have {i}you...{/i}or my {i}mom...{/i}because {i}you{/i} don’t love me...and she didn’t either until she had to.
lines.zh: : 也别跟我说我还有{i}你{/i}……或者{i}我妈{/i}……因为{i}你{/i}并不爱我……而她也是到了不得已才爱我的。

lines.en: : My dad is dead. The one thing keeping me going is dead.
lines.zh: : 我爸死了。唯一支撑我活下去的东西死了。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t I just die too?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是也该去死?

lines.en: : Maybe then, my mom wouldn’t have to hold in her tears. And you could have Nodoka become your new assistant since she’s already better than me.
lines.zh: : 也许那样,我妈就不用再忍着眼泪了。而你也可以让 Nodoka 当你的新助手,反正她已经比我强了。

lines.en: : It would all be better without me. The whole fucking world.
lines.zh: : 没有我,一切都会更好。整个他妈的世界都会。

lines.en: : I’m nothing but a burden to everyone.
lines.zh: : 我对所有人来说只是个负担。

lines.en: : There’s no one left that I want to live for.
lines.zh: : 已经没有让我想为之活下去的人了。

lines.en: : Then why not live for yourself?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不为你自己活?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain26
: Because that’s fucking stupid.
lines.zh: : 因为那太他妈蠢了。

lines.en: : How? That’s what I do.
lines.zh: : 怎么会?我不就是这么活的。

lines.en: : Yeah? And how’s that working out for you?
lines.zh: : 是吗?那你现在过得怎么样?

lines.en: scene makotosadagain27
: Fine, I guess.
lines.zh: : 还行吧,我想。

lines.en: : I’ve spent the last couple days slowly losing my grip on reality while worrying about you, but it’s not like I’m waking up every morning thinking about how I want to die.
lines.zh: : 这几天我一边担心你,一边慢慢失去对现实的掌控,不过我也没有每天早上醒来就想着自己多想死。

lines.en: : I’m just...having trouble getting to sleep. Which, all things considered, isn’t really that big of a problem compared to what some of the people I care most about are going through.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点睡不着。而综合来看,比起我最在乎的那些人正在经历的,这实在算不上什么大问题。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain28
: You really worried that much?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么担心我?

lines.en: : Does that surprise you?
lines.zh: : 这让你意外?

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain29
: I guess that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 我想这也合理。

lines.en: I recall an earlier thought — one about my hypocrisy reigning supreme as I leave a girl to rot.
lines.zh: 我想起了之前的一个念头——关于我的虚伪在我任由一个女孩烂掉时占据上风的那一个。

lines.en: And like clockwork, it will reign supreme once more right now.
lines.zh: 而像上了发条一样,它此刻又会再一次占据上风。

lines.en: Just this time, it will be in paradoxic contradiction to itself as my hypocrisy is squared until it comes full circle.
lines.zh: 只是这一次,它会以自相矛盾的悖论形式出现——我的虚伪被平方,直到绕回原点。

lines.en: : Have I ever helped you with {i}anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我到底帮过你{i}什么{/i}吗?

lines.en: : Because all this time, I’ve been telling myself that what I’ve been doing for you was what was best. But I don’t know if I ever actually believed that or if I just...{i}made{/i} myself believe it.
lines.zh: : 因为一直以来,我都在告诉自己,我为你做的那些事都是为了你好。可我不知道自己是不是真的相信过,还是只是……{i}让{/i}自己相信了。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m asking is...do you need something different from me? Or...{i}want{/i} something different from me?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……你需要我变得不一样吗?或者……{i}想要{/i}我变得不一样?

lines.en: : Should I be less of an asshole? {i}More{/i} of an asshole?
lines.zh: : 我该少当点混蛋?还是{i}多{/i}当点混蛋?

lines.en: : I’m just not sure with you.
lines.zh: : 我只是对你不太确定。

lines.en: : I think I’m normally pretty good at reading people but, for a while, it’s felt like every time I’ve tried to do that with {i}you,{/i} I’ve come up with nothing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我平时挺会看人的,可有一阵子了,每当我想对{i}你{/i}这么做,都一无所获。

lines.en: : I’m obviously not...trying to take the place of your father or anything. But I think having one more person on your side is something that could really benefit you right now.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是在……试图取代你父亲什么的。但我觉得,现在多一个站在你这边的人,对你真的会有好处。

lines.en: : Especially if you’re not going to let your mom be one of those people.
lines.zh: : 尤其是如果你不打算让你妈成为那些人中的一个的话。

lines.en: scene makotosadagain30
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Have you ever lost someone you loved?
lines.zh: : 你曾经失去过你爱的人吗?

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene makotosadagain30
: Someone that meant the world to you?
lines.zh: : 某个对你来说意味着全世界的人?

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene anormaldoor
scene makotosadagain31
: Does it ever get better?
lines.zh: : 这种事会好起来吗?

lines.en: scene imissyoumore
scene anormaldoor
scene spiderbug
scene makotosadagain32
: What can I do to make this all feel better?!
lines.zh: : 我该怎么做,才能让这一切好受一点?!
